Terms.s1Text: These Terms and Conditions apply to all attendees, whether passes are purchased directly through our website, via authorized promoters/ambassadors, or received via transfer or gift. By purchasing a pass, receiving a ticket from a promoter, redeeming a wristband, or entering festival grounds, you unconditionally agree to abide by these Terms. Authorized promoters are required to inform buyers of these terms prior to collecting payment.
Terms.s2Text: For direct website purchases: All ticket sales are final and non-refundable under any circumstances, including personal emergencies, attendee travel disruptions, artist lineup changes, schedule adjustments, or weather conditions. You may transfer your pass to another person through your account dashboard: until July 7th free of charge; from July 7th to July 26th for a 25 € fee; no changes permitted after July 27th. For purchases through a promoter: If you are unable to attend, your promoter will refund the pass amount excluding the non-refundable deposit owed to the organizers. The same transfer deadlines apply (free until July 7th; 25 € from July 7th to July 26th; no changes after July 27th). The organizers reserve the right to alter the schedule, venues, or artist lineup if necessary, and tickets remain non-refundable in cases of force majeure beyond our control.
Terms.s3Text: Summer Salsa Fest is dedicated to providing a safe, inclusive, and harassment-free experience for everyone. Any form of harassment, discrimination, or aggressive behavior on the dance floor or at the venues will result in immediate removal from the festival without a refund.
Terms.s4Text: Guest Dancers and Promoters are approved at the sole discretion of the organizers. Promoters act as authorized representatives for pass distribution. All attendees acquiring passes through a promoter are bound by the same festival rules, code of conduct, liability waivers, and non-refundable deposit terms outlined herein. Promoters are obligated to direct buyers to these terms upon sale. Misuse of the promoter portal, including selling passes at unauthorized discounts or creating fraudulent groups, will result in permanent bans and pass cancellations.
Terms.s5Text: By attending the festival, you consent to being filmed and photographed by our official media team. Summer Salsa Fest reserves the right to use this media for future promotional purposes across our website and social media without compensation.
Terms.s6Text: The organizers, Varna Free University, and Kabakum Beach venues are not liable for any personal injury, loss, or damage to belongings during the event. Attendees assume all risks associated with participation in dance activities.
Terms.s7Text: Please note that the Pre-Party and Goodbye Party are not included in the Full Pass or Party Pass. Entry for these events must be paid on-site in cash.
Terms.s8Text: On-site passes and tickets can only be purchased and collected at the official Info Desks located at Varna Free University (VFU) and the Beach Fiesta, strictly during their designated working hours. All on-site payments must be made in cash (Euros only).
Terms.s9Text: All pre-purchased passes must be collected in person at the Info Desk. Attendees are required to present a valid ID card or passport along with their digital QR code ticket.
Terms.s10Text: We respect your privacy and process your personal data in strict compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable EU laws. For full details on how we collect, store, and protect your information, please review our official Privacy Policy.
Terms.s11Text: Attendees under the age of 18 are welcome but must be accompanied by a parent, legal guardian, or an authorized adult escort at all times. In strict accordance with Bulgarian law, minors attending evening events (after 22:00) must present a valid, signed 'Declaration for Escort' (Декларация за придружител). Festival staff and security reserve the right to deny entry if proper legal documentation is not provided.
Terms.s12Text: Upon presenting your QR code ticket and a valid ID at the Info Desk, you will receive an official festival wristband. This wristband must be securely worn around your wrist at all times throughout the festival. Tampered, cut, lost, or stolen wristbands will not be replaced under any circumstances. Anyone found on the festival premises without a valid wristband will be asked to leave or must purchase a new pass.
Terms.s13Text: These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Bulgaria. Any legal disputes or claims arising out of or in connection with these terms, pass purchases, or attendance at Summer Salsa Fest shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in the Republic of Bulgaria.

Privacy.s1Text: Welcome to Summer Salsa Fest. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data in strict compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The Data Controller responsible for your personal information is ТК Маламбо ДЗЗД, registered under UIC 148016086, with a registered address at гр. Варна ул.Илинден №25. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.
Privacy.s2Li1Text: When you register, we collect your name and email address, and securely store your authentication credentials.
Privacy.s2Li2Text: We record your ticket ID, pass type, and purchase history. Payment details are handled securely by our third-party payment processor (Stripe) and are never stored on our servers.
Privacy.s2Li3Text: If you book a room through our platform, we collect your name and the duration of your stay to coordinate with partner hotels.
Privacy.s3Title: 3. How We Use and Share Your Data
Privacy.s3Text: We use your information strictly to provide and improve our festival experience:
Privacy.s3Li1: To generate, manage, and verify your event tickets and account.
Privacy.s3Li2: To coordinate room reservations by sharing only your name and stay duration with our partner hotels (hotels will collect their own required data at check-in).
Privacy.s3Li3: To communicate important festival updates, schedule changes, and respond to your inquiries.
Privacy.s4Text: We use local storage and cookies to ensure our website functions properly and to understand how visitors interact with our platform.
Privacy.s4Box1Text: These are required for the website to function securely (e.g., keeping you logged in). They cannot be switched off.
Privacy.s4Box2Text: If you accept, we load third-party scripts to help us measure site traffic and deliver relevant ads. You can opt-out at any time.
Privacy.s5Text: Your security is our priority. Our database utilizes industry-standard encryption and strict security rules. We retain your transactional and ticketing data for a period of 5 years to comply with Bulgarian tax and accounting laws. We will never sell your personal data to third parties.
Privacy.s6Text: Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data (the Right to be Forgotten). You also have the right to restrict or object to certain processing of your data.
Privacy.s7Text: Attendees under the age of 18 are permitted to create accounts and purchase tickets. However, by doing so, you confirm that you have the explicit consent of your parent or legal guardian to share your personal data (name and email) with us for the purpose of attending the festival.
Privacy.s8Text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, wish to exercise your GDPR rights, or request the deletion of your account data, please reach out to us at:

Cookies.s1Text: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit our website. They help us remember your preferences, keep your session secure, and understand how you interact with our platform.
Cookies.s2Text: Summer Salsa Fest uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience, manage your ticket cart, and analyze website traffic to improve our festival marketing.
Cookies.s3Box1Text: These cookies are essential for the website to function properly. They enable core features like logging into your account, adding passes to your cart, and secure checkout. They cannot be disabled.
Cookies.s3Box2Text: These cookies help us track visitor metrics (like which pages are most popular) using tools like Google Analytics. This data is aggregated and anonymous. You can opt out of these via our Cookie Banner.
Cookies.s4Text: You can change your cookie preferences at any time by clearing your browser data or by adjusting your browser settings to block third-party cookies.
Cookies.s5Text: If you have any questions regarding our use of cookies, please contact us at:

Info.sch1Desc: Masterclasses with over 50 international champions across 4 massive dance halls.
Info.sch2Desc: Cool down from the workshops with cocktails and social dancing right on the sand.
Info.sch3Desc: Spectacular shows, live bands, and social dancing across multiple rooms until sunrise.
Info.faq1q: Do I need a partner to attend?
Info.faq1a: Not at all! Summer Salsa Fest is incredibly social. During workshops, we constantly rotate partners, and during the parties, everyone dances with everyone.
Info.faq2q: How do I get to Varna Free University?
Info.faq2a: The university is located between Varna and Golden Sands. We recommend taking bus lines 409 or 9, which drop you off right near the campus. Taxi is also an option!
Info.faq3a: Yes! We have dedicated bootcamps and beginner-friendly tracks happening every single day. Look for the 'Green Track' on the official schedule.
Info.faq4a: Dance shoes (of course), swimwear for the beach socials, comfortable daytime clothes for workshops, and your best outfits for the evening gala parties!

Charity.title: Dance For A Cause
Charity.subtitle: Let's lend a hand together!
Charity.p1: Dancing unites us, but it can also do something much bigger – change human destinies!
Charity.p2: After each edition of Summer Salsa Fest, our team sets aside a portion of the funds collected from the sale of festival passes and tickets to support people going through difficult life trials.
Charity.p3: For two years now, we have also been organizing charity beach fiestas – with a dance floor, shade, sound system, and a DJ, where everyone can have fun, share their love for dancing, and at the same time become part of a good cause.
Charity.p4: Below we share the names of some of the people who have already received our support. We publish them to give voice to their causes and an opportunity for anyone who has the desire and ability to help personally.
Charity.ps: P.S. Please check the validity of the campaigns. Some of them may have ended.
Charity.p5: Every donation matters. Every outstretched hand brings hope!
Charity.p6: Let's turn the energy of dance into kindness and support together!

causes.name: I Believe and Help (Az vyarvam i pomagam)

JackJill.heroDesc: Step onto the dance floor, adapt to the music, and connect with a random partner! Show off your true social dancing skills in our exciting Jack & Jill competition.
JackJill.step1Desc: Leaders and followers are paired randomly. You won't know who you are dancing with until you step on the floor!
JackJill.step2Desc: The DJ chooses the songs. Adaptability, timing, and musicality are key to winning the judges' hearts.
JackJill.step3Desc: It's all about lead and follow. No choreographed routines—just pure, spontaneous social dancing.
JackJill.catNoviceDesc: For dancers with less than 2-3 years of experience who want to test their skills in a fun, pressure-free environment.
JackJill.catAdvancedDesc: For experienced dancers, instructors, and previous J&J winners ready to showcase top-tier musicality and technique.
JackJill.prizesDesc: Win Full Passes for next year's edition, private classes with our star instructors, festival merch, and exclusive sponsor gifts!
